name: synaptic_drift_hud
label: Synaptic Drift HUD
poeticVision: Feel the fragile grip on your own awareness as critical information slips from your sight. Your health, your memory count — they drift like fractured thoughts across the screen, demanding a desperate, split-second act of mental fortitude to pull them back into focus, lest your very ability to strategize unravels.

parameters.name: drift_speed
parameters.description: How fast elements drift (seconds per drift cycle).

parameters.name: max_drift_range
parameters.description: Maximum pixels elements can drift from their initial origin.

parameters.name: snap_duration
parameters.description: How fast elements snap back to their original position and clarity.

parameters.name: snap_focus_cost
parameters.description: Example resource cost incurred when the player snaps the HUD back into focus.

parameters.name: health_display
parameters.description: Reference to the Control node displaying health information.

parameters.name: memory_display
parameters.description: Reference to the Control node displaying memory count or status.

parameters.name: objective_display
parameters.description: Reference to the Control node displaying the current objective.

verdict: A brilliant manifestation of internal struggle, turning the very interface into a dynamic battleground for clarity and survival.
impact: This mechanic elevates the HUD from a passive information display to an active, challenging element of gameplay. It directly translates Lyra's internal struggle with memory loss into a tangible, player-facing obstacle, forcing constant engagement with the theme of identity dissolution. Players will experience a heightened sense of urgency and vulnerability, as maintaining mental clarity becomes a critical resource management task amidst the chaos of survival.
